title: Baris Belakang
mood: flirty and teasing, sweaty Thursday-night fun
subject: the clumsy man in the back row of the Thursday Zumba class at the community hall
caption: Malay reggaeton, Spanish-Malay Latin pop. A dembow riddim with the kick on every beat and a rimshot snare on the tresillo pattern, on the 'a' of one and the 'and' of two, repeated in the second half of the bar, timbale and rimshot fills at the ends of phrases, a deep sub-bass following the kick, a plucked nylon-string guitar hook doubled by a marimba-like synth, and reverse-cymbal risers into each chorus. Tight and dry, sub-heavy, the guitar hook and lead vocal forward, narrow verses opening wider on the chorus. Female lead, half-sung and half-rapped in Malay in the verses, a girl-group unison chorus, Spanish tag words on the hook, breathy ad-libs. 94 BPM, G minor. Flirty and teasing, sweaty Thursday-night fun. No house groove, no open-hat EDM pulse, no trap hi-hat rolls, no autotune, no dangdut kendang, no EDM drop.
lyrics:
[Intro - nylon guitar hook and rimshot]

[Verse 1]
Khamis malam, dewan orang ramai, kipas siling pusing perlahan
Cikgu Zumba jerit "kanan!", satu dewan pergi kanan
Kecuali dia, baris belakang, pakai baju larian tahun lepas
Dia pergi kiri, tersengih, minta maaf kat semua orang

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku patut tengok cermin depan
Tapi cermin tu pun tunjuk dia

[Chorus]
Baris belakang, dale, dale
Langkah kau salah, aku tak kisah
Baila conmigo, kalau kau berani
Minggu depan kau berdiri sebelah aku

[Verse 2]
Lagu ketiga, baju dia dah basah lencun
Botol air dia warna pink, ada nama anak buah dia
Lepas kelas dia tolong lipat tikar semua orang
Aku ambil masa lama sangat ikat tali kasut

[Bridge - rimshot and nylon guitar only]
Parking dewan dah gelap, dia tunggu aku hidupkan motor
"Khamis depan kau datang?" - aku buat-buat fikir dulu

[Chorus]
Baris belakang, dale, dale
Langkah kau salah, aku tak kisah
Baila conmigo, kalau kau berani
Minggu depan aku yang pindah ke belakang

[Outro - dembow and guitar hook, fading]
Khamis depan, pukul lapan
Aku simpan tempat, jangan lambat
